components.name: Price Card
components.description: Label over a 44px numeral; colour names the quantity.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 250px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #ff7a1a; border: 3px solid #111; padding: 8px 12px 10px; color: #111; } .ds-lab { font: 700 12px/1.2 'Archivo', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-num { font: 44px/1.1 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Zone Card (out and in)
components.description: Hatched ice when outside the ring, solid ink with yellow text when inside.
components.css: .ds-zone { width: 250px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #111; color: #fff200; border: 3px solid #111; padding: 8px 12px 10px; } .ds-zl { font: 700 12px/1.2 'Archivo', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-zone b { font: 30px/1.1 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; }

components.name: Objective Strip
components.description: Black strip, yellow text and border; states the next action.
components.css: .ds-obj { background: #111; color: #fff200; border: 3px solid #fff200; padding: 10px 12px; font: 700 15px/1.3 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-obj kbd { font: 700 12px 'Archivo', sans-serif; background: #fff200; color: #111; border: 2px solid #fff200; padding: 0 5px; margin: 0 2px; }

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Square button with hard offset shadow; pink variant for Sell.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 16px 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; padding: 13px 20px; background: #ff4fa3; color: #111; border: 3px solid #111; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #111; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn kbd { margin-left: 10px; font: 700 12px 'Archivo', sans-serif; border: 2px solid currentColor; padding: 0 5px; } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translate(-1px,-1px); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #111; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translate(2px,2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #111; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Upgrade Row
components.description: Price-list row: key badge, name, effect line, price card.
components.css: .ds-up { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; width: 340px; padding: 10px 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #111; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-k { border: 2px solid #111; background: #fff; font: 700 12px/22px 'Archivo', sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-up b { display: block; font: 16px/1.2 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; } .ds-fx { font: 500 13px/1.3 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-price { min-width: 86px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px 12px; background: #fff200; border: 3px solid #111; text-align: center; font: 22px/1.1 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; } .ds-up:hover .ds-price { background: #fff; } .ds-up:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Unaffordable Price
components.description: Hatched price card with a shortfall line.
components.css: .ds-short { display: inline-block; min-width: 86px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px 12px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #e8f1f5 0 4px, #fff 4px 8px); border: 3px solid #111; text-align: center; font: 22px/1.1 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; color: #111; } .ds-short small { display: block; font: 700 13px/1.3 'Archivo', sans-serif; }

components.name: Floating Price Tag
components.description: Bordered tag that drifts up: fish yellow, money orange, spend pink.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; background: #fff200; border: 3px solid #111; font: 20px/1.2 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; color: #111; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
Every number in the HUD is a fishmonger's price card slapped on crushed ice: fluorescent card stock, black marker ink, a 3px black border on everything. Hierarchy comes from scale alone, huge numerals against tiny uppercase labels, so the loop (sail into a ring, fish, sell, upgrade, return for the contract) reads at a glance over the saturated 3D sea.

State is carried by fill as well as colour: solid means live, hatched means unavailable or empty. The system is flat and square-cornered, with hard offset shadows only on things you press. It rejects the dark frosted-glass HUD with emoji icons and a coloured left edge that came before it.
keyCharacteristics: Three day-glo card colours plus ice and ink; nothing else.
3px ink border on every card, chip and button.
Hatched 45-degree stripes mark state; they are the only gradients.
No blur, no rounded corners, no emoji.

rules.name: The Pink Means Act Now Rule
rules.body: Pink appears only when the player should act immediately (hold full, Sell, a spend). Never use it decoratively.

rules.name: The Fill Is State Rule
rules.body: Colour never carries state alone: pair it with solid versus hatched (zone out is hatched ice, zone in is solid ink; unaffordable price is hatched, affordable is yellow, capped is solid ink).

rules.name: The 44 Rule
rules.body: Card numerals are 44px, not larger: 48px overflows the 250px card on four-digit hold and contract values.

rules.name: The Scale Is The Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Do not add weight, colour or decoration to rank text; change its size.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are offset, zero-blur, and ink (or the yellow on the win card). They signal pressable or modal, never decoration.

dos: Do put every number on a bordered card (3px ink) with a small uppercase label above it.
Do mark unavailable or empty states with the hatch pattern, and live states with a solid fill.
Do use pink only for act-now moments, orange only for money, yellow as the default.
Do keep numerals at 44px on 250px cards.
Do keep all shadows hard, zero-blur offsets, and press feedback as a translate plus a smaller shadow.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: no pulse, no banner scale, fade instead of drift.
donts: Don't use gradients other than the 45-degree hatch stripe, and no blur or backdrop-filter.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons.
Don't rank text by colour or weight; change size.
Don't convey state by colour alone.
Don't reintroduce frosted glass, translucent panels or coloured left edges.
